issue_context.title: .cast(pl.Datetime('ns', 'some_invalid_time_zone')) doesn't raise
issue_context.body:
### Polars version checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.


### Issue description

The code below doesn't error

### Reproducible example

```python
In [14]: pl.Series(['2020-01-01']).str.to_datetime().dt.replace_time_zone('UTC').cast(pl.Datetime('ns', 'fdafdsfasda'))
Out[14]:
shape: (1,)
Series: '' [datetime[ns, fdafdsfasda]]
[
        invalid timezone
]
```


### Expected behavior

I'd expect
```python
ComputeError: unable to parse time zone: 'fdasfsda'
```
